decisions.rationale: GitHub workflow files are repo control-plane. Current GitHub main includes the PR-triggerable workflow repair from Stage0F; the local OS copy is the older push-only version. Later import to OS is appropriate, but no file movement is authorized in Stage0I.
GitHub contains normal repo hygiene ignores and blocker-ledger exclusion; OS contains lockfile exclusions. Correct resolution is a union merge in GitHub, not unilateral overwrite by either side.

This path is in the OS runtime/data plane. The GitHub version is a remote-safe CI harness variant, while the OS version is the fuller local runtime harness. To avoid losing OS behavior, OS remains authoritative. A future stage should split the repo remote-safe harness into a repo-control path instead of sharing this runtime path.

Stage0H reported this common path as different from the older manifest, but current OS and GitHub content are effectively converged by Stage0I review. It is a repo manifest tool and remains GitHub authoritative for future repo-side changes.

reviewer: ChatGPT governed Stage0I adjudicator acting under user command
